title: JobFlow — vertical reels
note: Three 20–40 s vertical reels. Each scene is one or two fast cuts; captions are burned word by word from the TTS timestamps.

lines: Stop scrolling five hundred job posts.
JobFlow ranks every role by how well it fits your résumé.
Each card says why it fits, and what the gap is.
Pay is what the employer stated, or clearly marked as an estimate.
Filters only hide, and they tell you what they hid.
Free, open source, and it runs on your machine.

reels.title: It fills the form. You press submit.

lines: This tool fills in your job application, and then it stops.
First, a checklist: your name, your email, a résumé file.
Then it types what you stored, and attaches your résumé.
And it waits on the review screen. No auto-submit, ever.
You read it. You press submit.

reels.title: Your AI assistant + your job search

lines: Your AI assistant can run your job search.
Add JobFlow to Claude Code with one command.
Ask for remote backend roles you'd actually get.
It gets ranked jobs, with the honest gaps.
Plus a dry-run apply plan. It never fills or sends a form.
Your data stays on your machine. And JobFlow is open source.
